label: Make the flow canvas and its detail rail work on touch
inline_reason: no worker CLI probe passes on this machine; gesture work needing device verification in the same loop
red_gate: on the iPhone 16 simulator a node could not be dragged by touch at all — the first attempt moved nothing
discovered: the real blocker was NOT the rail width. TaskNode's title button carries `nodrag` and spans the node via flex-1; with the status chip, doc link and delete button also nodrag, the draggable surface was only the ~10px padding ring — workable with a mouse, unhittable by finger. Confirmed against xyflow source via Context7: `nodrag` is filtered at d3-drag's own filter over the whole ancestor chain, and `nodeDragThreshold` (default 1) separates tap from drag by distance while onClick still fires. Removed nodrag from the title and set nodeDragThreshold=4, which keeps tap-to-rename and enables drag-to-move from the same element.
dedup: AgentRunsPanel is reused unchanged inside the sheet rather than a second narrow variant
live_proof: iPhone 16 simulator: pinch zooms in and out; a node dragged from its title moved and the API confirmed 0,0 to 180.4,-228.8; a tap on the same title opened the rename editor with no drag. React Flow pane measures 358px of a 390px viewport. Responsive gate 56/56, full browser suite 98/98.
note: the floating Auto layout button overlapped the add-task form at 390px — moved to bottom-right and icon-only below the desktop breakpoint, the only free corner since zoom holds bottom-left
gate_resolution: auto lane — desktop canvas unchanged at lg and up, desktop route checks green
